emails.subject: Open quotations - visibility and responsibility
emails.body:
Dear {{first_name}},

In many companies, quotations remain open for weeks because no one knows who is responsible for the next step. Management only finds out when the opportunity is already lost.

Intrix CRM connects customer data, quotations, and sales team activity, so at any moment you can see what's in progress and where action is needed.

If this sounds interesting, I'd be happy to show you how it works in practice during a brief 15-minute conversation. Does any time next week work for you?

Best regards,
Brigita Kovačević

Intrix CRM povezuje podatke o klijentima, ponudama i aktivnostima prodajnog tima, pa u svakom trenutku vidite što je u tijeku i gdje treba reagirati.

emails.body:
Dear {{first_name}},

How much time does it take you today to find out what stage a quotation is in and who is responsible for the next step? In most companies, that means several calls and emails to colleagues.

In Intrix, you see this information in one place: open quotations, client agreements, and responsible parties. Management has an overview without additional inquiries, and no opportunity is forgotten.

If this interests you, take 15 minutes and I'll show you how it works in practice. Does any time next week work for you?

Best regards,
Brigita Kovačević

emails.body:
Dear {{first_name}},

Imagine you're on annual leave and your key client calls a colleague. Does he know what you last agreed on and which quotations are still open?

In Intrix CRM, all agreements, quotations, and reminders for the next contact are in one place. A colleague who covers for you or takes over a client immediately knows where you left off, and when you return, you don't need to remember anything.

If this interests you, I'd be happy to show you how it works in 15 minutes. Does any time next week work for you?

Best regards,
Brigita Kovačević
